content: SDP command addresses on Atmel 28C parallel EEPROMs are PART-SIZE DEPENDENT, not universal. AT28C256 (A14-A0) uses AAh->5555h, 55h->2AAAh, A0h->5555h (enable) and the 6-load ...80h/...20h disable. AT28C64B (A12-A0) uses the SAME data bytes at 1555h / 0AAAh. Cross-checked against the Microchip AT28C64B datasheet (DS20006432) and AT28C256 (DS20006386). Note 1555h = 5555h & 0x1FFF and 0AAAh = 2AAAh & 0x1FFF, so a hardcoded 5555/2AAA works on smaller parts ONLY by address-line truncation (upper lines absent on the package); it does NOT self-correct for parts LARGER than 32K where A15..A18 exist and must be driven low. Sequences are described as not interchangeable between parts.
